sections.title: Microsoft, the Benchmark Infrastructure for Governing, Accelerating, and Securing Organizations

paragraphs: Victrix identifies your needs, selects, and deploys Microsoft solutions tailored to your context. We establish clear governance that makes adoption manageable and measurable.
With Microsoft solutions, you can standardize your usage, secure your operations, and leverage AI where it creates the most value.

Microsoft is the trusted platform for private organizations and government agencies. By aligning collaboration, reliable business applications, and advanced analytics, Microsoft solutions accelerate execution and strengthen governance.
Its modular ecosystem integrates seamlessly with complex environments and supports large-scale deployments from the office to the field.

sections.title: Assess Your Needs and Structure Your Microsoft Adoption with Victrix
sections.body: Take advantage of our tailored support to select and deploy Microsoft solutions tailored to your organizational reality.

sections.sectionTitle: Harmonize Your Environment and Secure Your Operations with Microsoft Solutions
sections.intro: Standardize your practices, gain efficiency, and reinforce governance with Microsoft solutions distributed by Victrix. We help organizations replace fragmented tools with a structured environment focused on four pillars: processes, collaboration, AI, and analytics.

items.title: Microsoft 365
items.text:
Unify collaboration, messaging, and document management in a secure, compliant, and consistent environment.

Microsoft 365 standardizes workspaces and structures access and sharing.

Result: smoother collaboration, clear traceability, and simplified management.

items.title: Dynamics 365
items.text:
Align sales, customer service, field service management, and operations on a single platform.

Dynamics 365 automates processes and centralizes data for complete, actionable customer visibility.

Result: increased productivity, predictable operations, and enhanced service quality.

items.title: Power Platform
items.text:
Accelerate the creation of business applications, secure web portals, automation, and analytics.

Power Platform enables low-code app development, workflow orchestration, and dashboard publishing with full traceability and access control.

Result:shorter delivery times, standardized processes, and reliable indicators.

items.title: Microsoft Azure
items.text:
Build secure, flexible, and interoperable cloud foundations.

Azureunifies the management of identities, networks, virtual desktops, and AI and data services, even in hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

Result: reliable and secure deployments, simplified operations, and enhanced scalability.

items.title: Copilot for Microsoft 365
items.text:
Boost daily productivity with an AI assistant integrated into your Microsoft 365 applications.

Copilot accelerates writing, summarization, and meeting preparation while complying with M365 access rights and policies.

Result: time saved on repetitive tasks and greater focus on high-value activities.

items.title: Copilot Studio
items.text:
Create copilots aligned with your processes and business goals.

Copilot Studio connects your systems and data to design, orchestrate and publish customized AI agents, with integrated controls and governance policies.

Result: targeted, measurable use cases and controlled deployments.

items.title: Security
items.text:
Unify detection, access, and compliance on a single platform.

Microsoft's security suite combines XDR and SIEM capabilities (Defender, Sentinel), identity and access management (Entra ID), and data governance (Purview) with protection against phishing and malware and continuous application monitoring.

Result: measurable risk reduction, faster response time, and clear proof of compliance.

items.quote: Microsoft 365 offers good products, great service, robust user community, responsive and friendly help support staff, superb value by and large.
